_comment: Semantic part recipe for art/kenney-space-kit/craft_cargoA.obj. Coordinates are post scale+yaw (game space: nose -Z, +X starboard), matching the former shipped CargoA cube library. The hauler uses the same seven-part vocabulary as CargoB: two rear engines, two side pods, nose, tail, and a central fuselage. The x cuts sit 0.01 outside the natural |x|=0.8 seam so coplanar side skin stays with the central body and cut openings remain cap-friendly. Rules run in order; the remainder becomes the fuselage.
